audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Cassiopeia six of seven stages and Sion none, while Sion wins 53.72% over 1262 games. The packet flags the contradiction itself.
audit.why: Nothing in the kits, the packet or the mirror says which stage should flip, and the mirror explicitly recorded 'No change' for point 2. Inventing a power shift here would be worse than leaving the disagreement visible.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is and raised as a question. The stage prose was corrected instead — the level-2 and level-6 stages now describe the real mechanic rather than an invented one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma's cooldown is stated as 12 seconds in three separate places, and it is the number the entire kill window is built on.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — double the stated figure at rank 1. A player who believes the zone returns in 12s will start a charge into a live grounding every time.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], wants.you[1], whys[1] and mid all corrected to 24s at rank 1, 16s maxed. Noxious Blast's 3.5s and Twin Fang's 0.75s added so the poke cadence is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. The entry says Miasma 'cancels your unstoppable charge before it reaches her', and it never states the single most useful fact about Petrifying Gaze.
audit.why: Grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities — that stops you STARTING Unstoppable Onslaught while standing in the cloud; the mirror separately established that the charge itself is unstoppable and answered by Flash or a sidestep. And Riot's text on Petrifying Gaze is explicit: it stuns enemies in front of her that are FACING her, and merely slows anyone with their back turned. Charging her in a straight line is the one approach that guarantees the stun.
audit.corrected: whys[1], wants.foe[0] and mid restated as grounding denying the cast; whys[4] and mid now give the facing rule and the back-turned slow as the alternative approach.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls her level-1 damage 'Twin Fang Q', merging two different abilities into one wrong name.
audit.why: Noxious Blast is the Q poison zone (3.5s, 850 range); Twin Fang is the E that fires every 0.75s and hits harder on poisoned targets.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] now names both correctly with their cadences.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line although Twin Fang heals her for a share of every hit.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal on Twin Fang; against a champion whose whole plan is sustained chip, that buy decides whether the long fight is even possible.
audit.corrected: late now conditions 'do not solo duel her' on having anti-heal; wants.foe[1] states the heal.

edits.before: Miasma (W) comes online at level 2 and immediately grounds your R engage; every step forward is punished by a poison zone that cancels your unstoppable charge before it reaches her.
edits.after: Miasma lands at 2 and grounds you, so you cannot start Unstoppable Onslaught inside it; every step forward is punished by poison, and it is only up every 24s at rank 1.

edits.before: Your R engage at level 6 runs directly into her R face-stun — she turns and instant-stuns you mid-charge, then shreds the stunned target; use Unstoppable Onslaught to roam, not to all-in Cassiopeia.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her — charging straight in is the one thing that guarantees it, so use Unstoppable Onslaught to roam, or approach with your back turned and eat the slow.

edits.before: Before Cassiopeia has Miasma (W), her damage output is limited to Twin Fang Q — charge your Q in brush and she cannot ground you yet.
edits.after: Before Miasma exists her poke is Noxious Blast on 3.5s and Twin Fang — charge from brush at level 1, because nothing can ground you yet.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's W (Miasma) has a 12s cooldown — the instant the zone expires, E-shred into a fully charged Q knockup is your entire kill window.
edits.after: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and 16s maxed — the instant the zone expires, Roar of the Slayer into a fully charged knockup is your whole kill window.

edits.before: Bait Miasma (W) to waste the 12s cooldown, then immediately E-slow into the full-charge Q stun
edits.after: Bait Miasma out to waste its 24s cooldown, then E-slow straight into the full-charge stun

edits.before: Drop Miasma (W) under your feet the instant you step forward to cancel R engage and strand you in poke range
edits.after: Drop Miasma under your feet so you are grounded out of Unstoppable Onslaught and stranded in poke range

edits.before: Rotate Twin Fang (E) through your W-shield window with rapid-fire AP stacks so you cannot hold the shield long enough to detonate
edits.after: Fire Twin Fang every 0.75s into poisoned targets, healing off the damage, so Soul Furnace never survives to its 3-second detonation

edits.before: Miasma (W) is the whole matchup from level 2 onward — Cassiopeia drops it at your feet the moment you step forward, the ground zone cancels your R engage, and you are stranded in poison range eating Twin Fang stacks. The only correct trade is to charge Q in brush or fog, E-shred her step-up, and commit the instant Miasma ends (12s cooldown). Do not use R into a lane with Miasma active — she will drop the zone before your charge lands and your entire engage evaporates. At level 6, your R is primarily a roam tool here: Cassiopeia's face-stun (R) hard-counters your engage if you run straight at her, so use Unstoppable Onslaught to reach another lane, not to all-in her top.
edits.after: Miasma (W) is the whole matchup from level 2 onward — Cassiopeia drops it at your feet the moment you step forward, and grounded means you cannot start Unstoppable Onslaught at all while you stand in it. The only correct trade is to charge Q from brush or fog, shred her step-up with Roar of the Slayer, and commit the instant the zone expires — it is 24s at rank 1 and 16s maxed, so that gap is real. Do not walk into a live cloud expecting to charge out of it. At level 6 your R is primarily a roam tool here: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her, so a straight-line charge is the one approach she can always punish. Use it to reach another lane, not to all-in her top.

edits.before: At two items Cassiopeia's Twin Fang spam outpaces your HP regen and your W-shield value in a sustained 1v1 — do not solo duel her. Your role is to force her into teamfights where your zombie passive and enormous HP pool zone her team while your carries clean up; she cannot kite five people simultaneously. Heartsteel and the HP passive mean your reanimated zombie form is a legitimate threat that baits her ultimate (R face-stun) away from your team's engage. Accept that she won the lane, but your frontline scaling wins the game if you play teamfight angles instead of trying to outright kill her.
edits.after: At two items Twin Fang fires every 0.75s and heals her off each hit, so never solo duel her without Grievous Wounds already bought — anti-heal is the difference between a long trade and a free one for her. Your role is to force her into teamfights where your zombie passive and enormous HP pool zone her team while your carries clean up; she cannot kite five people. Your reanimated form also baits Petrifying Gaze away from your team's engage. Accept that she won the lane, but your frontline scaling wins the game if you play teamfight angles instead of trying to outright kill her.

notes: No full-layer entry exists for this matchup. The load-bearing number was wrong: Miasma is 24s at rank 1, not the 12s stated three times — the whole 'commit when the zone expires' plan was built on half the real cooldown. Added the Petrifying Gaze facing rule (stuns only those facing her, slows the back-turned), which is the highest-value unstated interaction in this lane. Left the level chart alone despite the packet's own contradiction flag; see questionsForUser.
